description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various categories, with each slice representing a different topic and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored blue, represents "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%, followed by "Daily Life" at 7.1% in light blue. "History" accounts for 8.2% in yellow, while "Science" and "Med & Health" each make up 6.7%, shown in light blue and green respectively. "Pet & Animal" is 5.5% in orange, and "Law" is 5.1% in red. Smaller segments include "Business" at 5.9% in red, "Geography" at 2.7% in yellow, "Math" at 1.2% in orange, and "Game&Anime" at 8.2% in green. The chart uses labels and percentages to clearly indicate the proportion of each category, with the largest slice, "Econ. & Fin.", being visually emphasized by its size and position.
